environment.description: Apache Tomcat 9.0.62 running on EC2 instance (m5.large) in VPC subnet 10.0.1.0/24. Application deployed as ROOT.war. PostgreSQL 14.3 RDS instance (db.r5.large) in same VPC, security group allows port 5432 from application subnet. DB user 'app_reports' has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on schema 'reporting'. No proxy or middleware between Tomcat and the internet-facing ALB (ALB configured with default listener forwarding all traffic to target group on port 8080). Session management via Tomcat's default JSESSIONID with 30-minute timeout.
